name: Lit Fields
description: A sign-up form whose field borders brighten with water-blue light where the pointer is.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading at the top of the panel.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the title.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the full-width submit button.

props.name: providers
props.description: Sign-in buttons shown under the divider. Pass an empty array to hide the divider and buttons.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with { firstName, lastName, email, password } once every field is valid. A returned promise shows a spinner on the button until it settles.

props.name: onProviderPress
props.description: Called when a sign-in button is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the panel. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Form.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Required fields get a mark after it.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field, hidden while an error shows.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Replaces the message from validate or native validation.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content at the end of the field, such as a small toggle button.

props.name: glowColor
props.description: Colour of the light that follows the pointer. Turns camellia while the field is invalid.

props.name: glowRadius
props.description: Radius of the light in pixels.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the field as required and validates it.

props.name: validate
props.description: Returns an error message for an invalid value. Shown after the form is submitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components TextField.
